notes.title: Moving Day 1.3 - Achievements Update
notes.content:
Today we have released version 1.3  of moving day.

This update includes some minor bug fixes as well as adding Achievements!

Release Notes

[list]
[*] Steamworks support added
[*] 6 New Achievements Added (1 for each ending)
[*] Fixed some minor issues causing extended load times
[*] Fixed the level of the doll on the first floor hallway so the player can now interact with it.
[*] Hint added to help with the Library Puzzle
[list]

notes.title: Day 0 Release. What we have and what is yet to come!
notes.content:
So here we are! Moving Day has now officially been released on steam!

But before you play there are a few things we should let you know.

Currently you will only have access to the "Short" version. But at some point in the next few months we will be releasing the Extended Version!

The extended version will be an update, not DLC! Meaning if you buy the game now you still get the extended version!

What will be different about the 2 versions?

Well the Extended version will be the full story that we have planned but ran out of time to implement for the deadline, so instead we made a shorter version of this.

When the Extended version is released all you need to to is update and start a new game. 

Stay tuned for more details once we have more news!

Thanks for joining us and see you soon!
